title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.235: Right of member of a company to copies of the Financial Statements and the auditor’s
description: Members' right to receive copies of the financial statements and the auditor's report.
practical_application: Sets the statutory distribution duty that the audit report serves; relevant to completion and reporting checklists.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.246: Appointment, removal and fee of auditors.— .......................................................... 142
description: Appointment, removal and fee of auditors: the first auditors are appointed by the board within 90 days of incorporation (retiring at the first AGM); subsequent auditors are appointed at the AGM on the board's recommendation with the proposed auditor's consent; members holding at least 10% may propose an auditor on 7 days' notice.
practical_application: Engagement acceptance: verify appointment was properly made and consent obtained before accepting.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.247: Qualification and disqualification of auditors.— ....................................................... 143
description: Qualification and disqualification: auditors of public companies, subsidiaries of public companies, and private companies with paid-up capital of Rs 3 million or more must be chartered accountants holding a valid ICAP certificate of practice, or firms of chartered accountants.
practical_application: Acceptance check: confirm the firm/partner meets the statutory qualification for the entity type.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.248: Auditors’ right to information.— .............................................................................. 145
description: Auditor's right of access at all times to the company's books, accounts and vouchers, and to require information or explanations from directors, officers, employees, and subsidiary undertakings.
practical_application: Backs the right-to-information request letter; a scope limitation here has reporting consequences.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.249: Duties of auditor.— .................................................................................................. 146
description: Duties of the auditor: conduct the audit and prepare the report in compliance with ISAs as adopted by ICAP; examine whether adequate accounting records were kept and whether the financial statements agree with the records.
practical_application: The statutory anchor for ISA compliance in Pakistan — the legal reason the ISA procedures in this database apply.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.250: Audit of cost accounts.— .......................................................................................... 148
description: Audit of cost accounts where the law requires cost records to be maintained.
practical_application: Specialist engagement area; scope depends on the applicable cost-accounting rules.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.251: Signature of auditor’s report.— ................................................................................ 148
description: Signature of the auditor's report: must state the auditor's name and the engagement partner, and be signed, dated, with the place of signature stated; a firm's report is signed in the firm's name with the engagement partner named.
practical_application: Report assembly checklist item; signing errors are a completion-procedure catch.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.252: Penalty for non-compliance with provisions by companies.— .................................. 148
description: Penalty of level 3 on the standard scale for companies contravening sections 246, 247, 248 or 250.
practical_application: Context for management-letter points on statutory non-compliance.

title: Companies Act, 2017 — s.253: Penalty for non-compliance with provisions by auditors.— ...................................... 148
description: Penalty of level 2 on the standard scale for auditors whose report does not conform with sections 131, 249 or 251, or is untrue or omits material facts; higher penalty where done with intent to profit or to cause loss.
practical_application: Professional-risk context: why report conformity checks matter.

title: ICAP Code of Ethics — Part 1: complying with the Code, fundamental principles and conceptual framework
description: Part 1 sets the core of the Code: the five fundamental principles (integrity; objectivity; professional competence and due care; confidentiality; professional behavior) and the conceptual framework for identifying, evaluating and addressing threats to compliance.
practical_application: Use for independence checks, threat evaluation, and ethics consultations; Part 4A governs audit engagements.
licence: ICAP member publication; do not republish

title: ICAP Code of Ethics — Part 2: chartered accountants in business
description: Requirements and guidance for members employed in business, including conflicts, preparation of information, and inducements.
practical_application: Use for independence checks, threat evaluation, and ethics consultations; Part 4A governs audit engagements.
licence: ICAP member publication; do not republish

title: ICAP Code of Ethics — Part 3: chartered accountants in practice
description: Requirements for members in practice: appointment, conflicts, second opinions, fees, custody of client assets, and objectivity.
practical_application: Use for independence checks, threat evaluation, and ethics consultations; Part 4A governs audit engagements.
licence: ICAP member publication; do not republish

title: ICAP Code of Ethics — Part 4A: independence for audit and review engagements
description: The independence standards applicable to audit and review engagements — the part most directly relevant to external audit work.
practical_application: Use for independence checks, threat evaluation, and ethics consultations; Part 4A governs audit engagements.
licence: ICAP member publication; do not republish

title: ICAP Code of Ethics — Part 4B: independence for assurance engagements other than audit and review
description: Independence standards for other assurance engagements.
practical_application: Use for independence checks, threat evaluation, and ethics consultations; Part 4A governs audit engagements.
licence: ICAP member publication; do not republish
